description: This file defines chart type limitations, including maximum dimensions, warning messages, and utility functions related to chart types in a dashboard application.

methods.name: getChartTypeLimitation
methods.description: Returns the limitation details for a specific chart type, or null if none exists.

methods.name: isSingleColumnDimensionChart
methods.description: Checks if a chart type supports only a single column dimension.

methods.name: isChartWithoutGroupBy
methods.description: Checks if a chart type does not require a group by clause.

methods.name: limitColumnsForChartType
methods.description: Limits the columns based on chart type limitations and provides warnings for ignored columns.
